article.headline: McLaughlin scores 30 as Northern Arizona downs Weber State 80-77
article.description: — Trenton McLaughlin's 30 points led Northern Arizona over Weber State 80-77 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: McLaughlin scores 30 as Northern Arizona downs Weber State 80-77

categories.description: Weber State Wildcats @ Northern Arizona Lumberjacks

event.description: Weber State Wildcats @ Northern Arizona Lumberjacks

keywords: Weber State Wildcats @ Northern Arizona Lumberjacks
article.story: FLAGSTAFF, Ariz. -- — Trenton McLaughlin's 30 points led Northern Arizona over Weber State 80-77 on Saturday night. McLaughlin also had seven rebounds for the Lumberjacks (10-5, 1-1 Big Sky Conference). Jayden Jackson scored 21 points, shooting 7 of 14 from the field and 5 for 6 from the line. Vasilije Vucinic finished with 19 points and eight rebounds for the Wildcats (6-10, 0-2). Blaise Threatt added 15 points and six assists for Weber State. Dyson Koehler had 13 points and two steals. A 3-pointer by McLaughlin gave NAU a 76-73 lead with 1:24 remaining. Oakland Fort made a layup and later two free throws to wrap it up for the Lumberjacks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
